verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents a broad REST API, an official SDK, and an API changelog, which records that legacy bearer tokens were replaced with JWT tokens. Nothing in the evidence shows API versioning (versioned endpoints or version headers) or a published deprecation policy with timelines or notice periods. A changelog entry is adjacent evidence, not the versioning and deprecation guarantee the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
